messages:
jonah: quick follow-up from the Tue AM throughput regression postmortem. root cause: incorrect scale-down grace + a delayed queue-drain hook on a subset of Dedicated pools. we need short-term SLO/SLA mitigations and medium-term operational fixes. proposing the list below for owners/timelines.

maya: thanks for the writeup. I'll own the SLO/SLA change proposal. idea: introduce a conditional throughput floor during 05:30-08:30 UTC (weekday) so autoscaler doesn't collapse capacity during steady ramp. i'll draft the SLO change doc today.

liam: i'll take the alerting cooldown work. plan is to add a 20m quiet-period window for paging during known ramp window, and add a non-paging severity for early warnings. will add alert template and runbook edits.

sophie: i'll handle the dashboard and capacity reservation task. adding a panel for "inflight queue length" and a capacity-reservation gauge per pool. will tag the dashboard with links to runbook.

jonah: action items (rough):
- SLO change: add conditional throughput floor (requests/sec) for 05:30-08:30 UTC weekdays; owner: maya; due: 2026-03-28.
- Alert cooldowns: non-paging early-warning alert + 20m paging delay during ramp window; owner: liam; due: 2026-03-26.
- Dashboard updates: queue length panel + reservation gauge + link to runbook; owner: sophie; due: 2026-03-24.
- Autoscaler fix: honor drain-timeouts and avoid aggressive scale-to-zero for dedicated pools; owner: infra team (jonah coordinating); due: 2026-04-02.
- Retro/recurrence analysis: 60/90-day sliding window to detect weekday pattern; owner: maya; due: 2026-03-30.

liam: sample alert YAML i'll add to the PR (very rough):
```yaml
alert: ThroughputEarlyWarning
expr: sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[2m])) < (throughput_floor * 0.85)
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "Throughput dropped below expected floor (early warning)"
```
will include the paging-suppression logic tied to time window in the runbook.

maya: for the SLO text i propose adding an explicit clause: "During weekday ramp window (05:30-08:30 UTC) SLO evaluation uses a 15m rolling average and a 10% slack on the throughput floor to avoid transient scale flaps." i'll post the formal SLO diff in the docs repo.

sophie: prometheus query for the new panel (draft):
``
avg_over_time(redwood_queue_length[5m])
```
and a gauge: `max_over_time(machine_reserved_capacity[1h])` to show reservations. i'll push Grafana JSON soon.

ops-bot: Incident 2026-03-24-11: throughput-regression closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-24-throughput-regression. Action items attached.

jonah: recapping: owners please drop PRs/links in this thread when ready. planning a 20-min sync on 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC to review SLO wording + alerts. if anyone needs to move due dates, call it out here.

liam: ack, will have alert PR by 2026-03-26 as planned.

maya: ack, SLO draft today.

sophie: ack, dashboard by 2026-03-24 EOD."
